items.question: How does Postmatic.id work?
items.answer: Postmatic.id is an AI/ML-driven digital marketing platform that automates your entire social media workflow—from trend research, visual content creation, caption writing, to automated post scheduling.

items.question: Is Postmatic.id free to use?
items.answer: Yes, you can create a free account to test the core features of Postmatic.id and experience automated content creation before upgrading to a paid subscription.

items.question: Can I customize the AI-generated content?
items.answer: Absolutely! All visual assets, captions, and publishing schedules generated by AI can be fully edited, customized, or previewed before going live.

items.question: Does Postmatic.id integrate with major social media platforms?
items.answer: Yes, Postmatic.id supports seamless integration with popular social media platforms including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, WhatsApp, and LinkedIn.

items.question: Is Postmatic.id suitable for SMEs and local businesses?
items.answer: Definitely! Postmatic.id is tailored for business owners and SMEs to manage digital marketing effortlessly without needing design skills or dedicated social media staff.

The words of which the initial letter is capitalized have meanings defined under the following conditions.

content.text: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They help us operate the site, enhance your experience, analyze traffic, and serve relevant advertisements.
We use cookies for the purposes described below. You can control non-essential cookies via our Cookie Settings modal at any time.

items:
1. Necessary Cookies (Always Active)
Essential for basic website functionality, security, and network management. Without these, services such as logging in or filling forms cannot be provided.

2. Analytics Cookies
Collect information in aggregate—such as number of visitors, pages viewed, and session duration—to help us understand how the site is used and improve performance.

3. Marketing / Advertising Cookies
Track visitors across websites to display relevant, personalized ads and measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns.

content.text: We may allow trusted third-party services (e.g., Google Analytics, Meta Pixel) to set cookies for analytics or marketing purposes. These providers are contractually bound to handle data responsibly and in accordance with applicable law.
When you first visit Postmatic, you will see a cookie-consent banner. You may:

items: Accept all cookies;
Reject all optional cookies;
Open "Cookie Settings" to choose individual categories.

content.text: You can revisit or change your choices at any time by clicking the "Cookie Settings" link in the footer or by clearing local storage and refreshing the page.

Cookie retention periods vary by category: necessary cookies expire after the session or within 30 days; analytics cookies may persist up to 24 months; marketing cookies are typically retained for 6–12 months or until you revoke consent.
If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy, please contact us:

items.question: How does Postmatic help promote my business?
items.answer: Postmatic automatically generates content ideas, writes persuasive captions in a range of tones of voice, designs ready-to-post promotional visuals, and schedules them straight to your social media accounts in minutes, with no technical design skills required.

items.question: Is there a monthly subscription fee?
items.answer: No. Postmatic is pay-as-you-go: you only pay for the tokens you use.

items.question: Can I try Postmatic for free?
items.answer: Yes. New users receive 10,000 free tokens after completing their business profile, to try Postmatic's main features.

items.question: Is the content and visual output guaranteed to be unique to my brand?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our AI learns your brand identity and produces content and visuals that are 100% original and unique to your business.

items.question: What happens when my token balance runs out?
items.answer: You can top up tokens at any time from the dashboard, without a monthly subscription.

items.question: Which social media platforms are supported?
items.answer: We currently support Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok. More platforms are coming soon.

features.title: No Subscription Fees
features.description: No monthly fees or binding contracts. You only pay for what you use through a transparent token system. New users get 10,000 free tokens after completing their business profile.

features.title: Full Control & Transparency
features.description: Full, real-time control over your token balance. Tokens never expire (automatic roll-over) while your account is active.

features.title: Access to Every Platform
